option_relations.rationale: The option 'NK/T-Cell Lymphoma, Nasal Type' is a direct translation and common name for 'Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type (or aggressive)', which is represented by the leaf 'pred_1'.
Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma is a subtype of Peripheral T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
The option 'Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma' is a direct match to the common English name for the leaf 'pred_1' (结外NK/T细胞淋巴瘤，鼻型（或侵袭性）).
ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma is a distinct type of T-cell lymphoma and is not directly related to Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.
